name: hoshirube-backend
description: ほしるべ MVP の Lambda バックエンド（API Gateway HTTP API v2）

scripts.build: esbuild src/handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.dev: esbuild src/dev-server.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --log-level=warning --outfile=dist/dev-server.mjs "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node dist/dev-server.mjs
